title: Students & Young Adults
description: Protecting social media profiles, avoiding part-time job traps, and preventing gaming/crypto scams.
descriptionMr: सोशल मीडिया सुरक्षितता, पार्ट-टाईम जॉब फ्रॉडपासून बचाव आणि सुरक्षित गेमिंग.

tips.heading: Enable 2-Step Verification Everywhere
tips.detail: Activate 2FA on Instagram, WhatsApp, Snapchat, and Discord using Google Authenticator or SMS PIN.

tips.heading: Beware of 'Easy Money' Part-time Jobs
tips.headingMr: रोज ५००० रुपये कमवा' अशा मेसेजेसवर विश्वास ठेवू नका
tips.detail: No legitimate job pays Rs 2,000 daily for liking YouTube videos or completing Telegram tasks.

tips.heading: Protect Intimate Photos & Camera Permissions
tips.detail: Never engage in explicit video calls with unknown online acquaintances. Use StopNCII.org if photos are leaked.

tips.heading: Don't Share Verification OTPs with Friends
tips.detail: If a friend's Instagram messages asking for a 6-digit code, their account is already hacked!

title: Senior Citizens
description: Guarding pension accounts, identifying fake bank/police calls, and safe messaging practices.
descriptionMr: पेन्शन खाते संरक्षण, बनावट बँक व पोलीस कॉल्सपासून सावधानता.

tips.heading: UPI PIN is ONLY for SENDING Money
tips.headingMr: यूपीआय पिन फक्त पैसे पाठवण्यासाठी असतो
tips.detail: You NEVER enter your UPI PIN to RECEIVE pension, refunds, or customer care credits.

tips.heading: Ignore Threats of 'Digital Arrest'
tips.detail: Police or CBI will NEVER arrest anyone over WhatsApp or Skype video calls or ask for money.

tips.heading: Verify Customer Care Numbers on Official Sites
tips.headingMr: कस्टमर केअर नंबर फक्त अधिकृत वेबसाईटवरून घ्या
tips.detail: Never call phone numbers found in Google search images; they are often set up by scammers.

tips.heading: Keep Daily UPI & Bank Transfer Limits Low
tips.detail: Set a low daily transaction limit (e.g. Rs 5,000) on your mobile banking app for safety.

title: Working Professionals
description: Securing corporate emails, avoiding stock market trading scams, and protecting identity documents.
descriptionMr: कॉर्पोरेट ईमेल सुरक्षा, ट्रेडिंग फ्रॉडपासून बचाव आणि ओळखीचे दस्तऐवज संरक्षण.

tips.heading: Cross-Check Stock Trading Brokers on SEBI Portal
tips.headingMr: शेअर मार्केट ब्रोकर सेबी (SEBI) मान्यताप्राप्त आहे का तपासा
tips.detail: Never transfer money into personal savings accounts for stock market trading.

tips.heading: Mask Aadhaar Before Sharing Copies Online
tips.detail: Use UIDAI's Masked Aadhaar feature so only the last 4 digits are visible for hotel/sim verification.

tips.heading: Audit Registered Mobile Numbers on Sanchar Saathi
tips.headingMr: संचार साथीवर तुमच्या नावावरील सीम तपासा
tips.detail: Visit tafcop.sancharsaathi.gov.in every 6 months to check if any unauthorized SIM is issued in your name.

tips.heading: Watch for Phishing Emails Claiming Tax Refunds
tips.headingMr: टॅक्स रिफंडच्या बनावट ईमेलपासून सावध राहा
tips.detail: Income tax departments send official communications from @incometax.gov.in domain only.

title: Parents & Guardians
description: Monitoring children's online safety, preventing gaming in-app purchase debt, and cyberbullying awareness.
descriptionMr: पालकांसाठी ऑनलाईन बाल-सुरक्षा आणि सायबर बुलिंग प्रतिबंध मार्गदर्शक.

tips.heading: Set Up Family Link & Parental Controls
tips.detail: Use Google Family Link to restrict unknown APK downloads and set app time limits.

tips.heading: Do Not Save Credit Card Details on Kids' Devices
tips.headingMr: मुलांच्या गेममध्ये क्रेडिट कार्ड सेव्ह करू नका
tips.detail: Disable one-click in-app purchases on gaming apps (Free Fire, BGMI) to prevent accidental charges.

tips.heading: Open Dialogue About Online Harassment & Stalking
tips.detail: Ensure children know they can talk to you without fear if someone threatens or blackmails them online.
